comment: T-4.35: the enemy fighter's variants (standing rule 4: the look is data). One geometry and one atlas; a variant picks the headgear (pakol or turban) and multiplies the pale-painted cloth and headgear by its colours (sRGB hex). An enemy's variant is its netId modulo the list, so a group of fighters is a mix and a fighter keeps its look for its life. The MG gunner adds the bandolier, whatever the variant.
